props.title: Make data and structure easier to understand
props.lead: Charts, mind maps, flowcharts, and technical diagrams are built-in components. Insert them into a Page or Board; their interactions also work in offline exports. This page includes live components you can try.

content.text: Components are provided at the discretion of the reader. The flow chart below is itself an "interactive flow chart" component: click on the node to read the description, and you can zoom in and out after unlocking the upper right corner.

nodes.label: What do you want readers to understand?
nodes.detail: Think clearly about the judgment that the reader wants to complete before selecting components. If the same data is expressed in another way, readers may get completely different conclusions.

nodes.label: relationship between a set of numbers
nodes.detail: Compare sizes, look at trends, look at composition, look at distribution or variable relationships.

content.text: According to what readers want to see, the 43 types of charts are roughly divided into the following categories (grouped for this article):
Column chart, grouped bar chart, stacked bar chart, bidirectional bar chart, radial bar chart, bullet chart, radar chart, dashboard
Line Chart, Area Chart, Stacked Area Chart, Candlestick Chart, Kagi Turn Chart, Spiral Chart, Gantt Chart
Pie chart, donut chart, rose chart, funnel chart, mosaic chart
Rectangular tree diagram, sunburst diagram, circular package diagram
Histogram, box plot, violin plot, distribution curve, stem and leaf plot
Scatter plots, bubble plots, regression curves, parallel coordinates, density heat maps, contour plots, color block plots
Sankey diagram, chord diagram, arc diagram, Venn diagram
Bubble map, graded color map, point map

Select the chart to open the settings: title, height, font size, line width, color palette, theme (ShowAI indigo, classic, dark), legend and animation can be changed directly. Data, field correspondence and other parameters are in "Data and Advanced Parameters" and can be edited in JSON.

content.text: Points to the parent node, arranged in array order under the same parent node.
Node IDs and names can be up to 200 characters long, for a maximum of 500 nodes. Duplicate IDs, missing parent nodes, cycles, and multiple root nodes are all rejected.

Good for explaining processes, branches and dependencies. A flowchart component can contain multiple switchable processes, each process has its own nodes and connections, and the direction is from top to bottom or left to right. Nodes can have descriptions, on-demand query commands and reference documents, which can be expanded when readers click on them.

The node type determines the appearance: user intent, skill entry, conditional judgment, on-demand documents, CLI query, and results. Each process has a maximum of 200 nodes and 400 connections, and a component has a maximum of 20 processes. It is locked by default when embedded in the page, and can be zoomed and panned after unlocked.
Graphic components: Archify, Diagram Design, Fireworks

These three types of graphic components directly display the SVG or HTML generated by the original project in the "Process" category of the component library. The built-in templates are editable examples, please replace them with your own facts when making documents.

content.text: Select the component to open the settings. You can change the template, change the text in the image, import HTML/SVG files or edit the complete source code. "Graphic Presentation" defaults to a concise style: the title and description are placed outside the figure, and the supplementary description is hidden; selecting "Original" can restore the complete upstream graphics.

The graph is locked by default and the page scrolls as normal; when unlocked use exploration and zooming within the graph. Selection while reading will not overwrite the saved source code. Please embed fonts, pictures and icons in imported graphics. The reader's isolation frame does not allow external requests.
